## Load data

```{python}
from IPython.display import display
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent / "database_module"))

from db_handler import DbHandler, DbUtils
from db_config import USERNAME, PASSWORD, DATABASE_NAME, HOST, PORT, PGS_EXCEL_FILEPATH


db_handler = DbHandler(port=PORT, db_url=None, user=USERNAME, password=PASSWORD, host=HOST)

db_handler.connect()

db_utils = DbUtils(db_handler)



user_pgs_scores = pd.read_csv(
    r"C:\Users\frezz\Downloads\snpster\data pipeline\reporting_module\data\multiple_pgs_scores_example.zip", sep="\t"
)

"""
Index(['sampleset', 'FID', 'IID', 'PGS', 'SUM', 'Z_MostSimilarPop', 'Z_norm1',   
       'Z_norm2', 'percentile_MostSimilarPop'],
      dtype='str')
"""


#get metadata

user_pgs_scores["PGS"] = user_pgs_scores["PGS"].str.replace("_hmPOS_GRCh38", "", regex=False)

#only keep sampleset column != reference

user_pgs_scores = user_pgs_scores[user_pgs_scores["sampleset"] != "reference"]


meta_data_query = f"""
SELECT pgs_id, reported_trait, efo_id, number_of_variants,pgp_id, publication_pmid,publication_doi,ftp_link,release_date,ancestry_distribution_source_of_variant_associations_gwas,ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation 
FROM data_libraries.pgscatalog_data
WHERE pgs_id IN ({', '.join([f"'{pgs}'" for pgs in user_pgs_scores['PGS'].unique()])})
"""

meta_data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(meta_data_query)


publications_meta_data_query = f"""SELECT first_author, title, journal_name, publication_date, pgp_id 
FROM data_libraries.pgs_publications
WHERE pgp_id IN ({', '.join([f"'{pgp}'" for pgp in meta_data['pgp_id'].unique()])})
"""

publications_meta_data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(publications_meta_data_query)

pgs_performance_data_query = f"""SELECT pgp_id, hazard_ratio, odds_ratio, auroc, ppm_id, pgs_id, pss_id 
FROM data_libraries.pgs_performance
WHERE pgs_id IN ({', '.join([f"'{pgs}'" for pgs in user_pgs_scores['PGS'].unique()])})
"""

pgs_performance_data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(pgs_performance_data_query)

display(user_pgs_scores.head())
display(meta_data.head())
display(publications_meta_data.head())
display(pgs_performance_data.head())


overview_query = f"""
SELECT  pp.auroc, pp.odds_ratio, pp.hazard_ratio, pp.ppm_id, pp.pgs_id, pp.pss_id, pp.pgp_id, cd.reported_trait, cd.efo_id, cd.number_of_variants, cd.pgp_id, cd.publication_pmid, cd.publication_doi, cd.ftp_link, cd.release_date, cd.ancestry_distribution_source_of_variant_associations_gwas, cd.ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation, es.*, sd.*
FROM data_libraries.pgs_performance pp
LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgscatalog_data cd
ON pp.pgs_id = cd.pgs_id
LEFT JOIN data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets es
ON  pp.pss_id = es.pss_id
LEFT JOIN data_libraries.score_development_samples sd
ON pp.pgs_id = sd.pgs_id
WHERE pp.auroc IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        pp.hazard_ratio IS NOT NULL
        OR pp.odds_ratio IS NOT NULL
      )
	AND individuals_development > 50000
	AND individuals_evaluation > 1000
	AND auroc > 0.65
ORDER BY cd.reported_trait, pp.auroc DESC;

"""



```


## Prepare data


```{python}

#print all columns of user_pgs_scores, meta_data, publications_meta_data, pgs_performance_data
#print("user_pgs_scores columns:", user_pgs_scores.columns.tolist())
#print("meta_data columns:", meta_data.columns.tolist())

#print("pgs_performance_data columns:", pgs_performance_data.columns.tolist())



user_pgs_scores = user_pgs_scores.merge(
    meta_data,
    left_on="PGS", #default column name from the prs_catalog nextlfow output
    right_on="pgs_id",
    how="left"
)

print(user_pgs_scores.columns.tolist())

user_pgs_scores = user_pgs_scores.merge(
    pgs_performance_data,
    left_on=["pgs_id", "pgp_id"],
    right_on=["pgs_id", "pgp_id"],
    how="left"
)

print(user_pgs_scores.columns.tolist())

user_pgs_scores = user_pgs_scores.merge(
    publications_meta_data,
    left_on="pgp_id",
    right_on="pgp_id",
    how="left"
)


print(user_pgs_scores.columns.tolist())

```
```{python}
import numpy as np



user_pgs_scores["individual_hazard_ratio"] = (
    user_pgs_scores["hazard_ratio"].astype(float) ** user_pgs_scores["Z_MostSimilarPop"].astype(float)
)

user_pgs_scores["individual_odds_ratio"] = (
    user_pgs_scores["odds_ratio"].astype(float) ** user_pgs_scores["Z_MostSimilarPop"].astype(float)
)

user_pgs_scores["individual_risk_ratio"] = (
    user_pgs_scores["individual_hazard_ratio"].combine_first(
        user_pgs_scores["individual_odds_ratio"]
    )
)

user_pgs_scores["risk"] = (
    (user_pgs_scores["individual_risk_ratio"] - 1) * 100
)
#add column showing if score is hazard ratio or odds ratio

conditions = [
    user_pgs_scores["risk"].isna(),
    user_pgs_scores["individual_hazard_ratio"].notna(),
    user_pgs_scores["individual_odds_ratio"].notna(),
]

choices = [
    "percentile",
    "hazard_ratio",
    "odds_ratio",
]

user_pgs_scores["risk_type"] = np.select(conditions, choices, default=None)

user_pgs_scores["risk"] = user_pgs_scores["risk"].fillna(user_pgs_scores["percentile_MostSimilarPop"])

user_pgs_scores["performance_score_id"] = user_pgs_scores["pgs_id"] + "_" + user_pgs_scores["pss_id"].astype(str)

print(user_pgs_scores.columns.tolist())

```

## table

```{python}

df = publications_meta_data.copy()



# Convert everything to display-friendly strings (avoids weird formatting / NaNs)
df_display = df.fillna("").astype(str)

# Align numeric-looking columns to the right, others left
def is_numeric_col(series: pd.Series) -> bool:
    s = pd.to_numeric(series.replace("", pd.NA), errors="coerce")
    return s.notna().mean() > 0.85  # mostly numeric

col_align = ["right" if is_numeric_col(df[c]) else "left" for c in df.columns]

# Zebra striping
row_colors = ["white" if i % 2 == 0 else "#F7F8FA" for i in range(len(df_display))]

fig = go.Figure(
    data=[
        go.Table(
            columnwidth=[1] * len(df_display.columns),
            header=dict(
                values=[f"<b>{c}</b>" for c in df_display.columns],
                fill_color="#F1F3F5",
                font=dict(color="#111827", size=13, family="Inter, Arial"),
                align="left",
                height=36,
                line_color="#E5E7EB",
            ),
            cells=dict(
                values=[df_display[c].tolist() for c in df_display.columns],
                fill_color=[row_colors],  # zebra stripes across rows
                font=dict(color="#111827", size=12, family="Inter, Arial"),
                align=col_align,
                height=30,
                line_color="#E5E7EB",
            ),
        )
    ]
)

fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(
        text="Publications Metadata",
        x=0,
        xanchor="left",
        font=dict(size=18, family="Inter, Arial", color="#111827"),
    ),
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=55, b=0),
    height=min(850, 140 + 28 * (len(df_display) + 1)),  # auto-ish height
)

fig.show()
```
